definitions.explanation: A flexible container made of paper, plastic, or cloth used for carrying or storing things.

examples.japanese: {袋|ふくろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
⟦レジ→レジ：00879_reji⟧{袋|ぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give me a plastic bag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{袋|ふくろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put the things I bought in a bag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧、{袋|ふくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ってくる→持ってくる：10666_mottekuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, many people bring their own bags when shopping because bags cost money.

notes:
{袋|ふくろ} means bag or sack - a flexible container for carrying or storing things.

TYPES:
- ⟦レジ{袋|ぶくろ}→レジ袋：09531_rejibukuro⟧: shopping bag (at register)
- ⟦{紙|かみ}{袋|ぶくろ}→紙袋：09705_kamibukuro⟧: paper bag
- ⟦ビニール{袋|ぶくろ}→ビニール袋：09704_biniirubukuro⟧: plastic bag
- ⟦エコバッグ→エコバッグ：08937_ekobaggu⟧/⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧{袋|ぶくろ}: reusable shopping bag
- ⟦{手提|てさ}げ→手提げ：18403_tesage⟧{袋|ぶくろ}: tote bag with handles
- ⟦{寝袋|ねぶくろ}→寝袋：06991_nebukuro⟧: sleeping bag
- ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧{袋|ぶくろ}: pay envelope

COUNTER:
⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧ for flat bags, ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧ for filled bags

SHOPPING IN JAPAN:
Since 2020, plastic bags cost money at most stores. Staff often ask:
- {袋|ふくろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いります→要る：09589_iru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？: Do you need a bag?
- {袋|ふくろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有料|ゆうりょう}→有料：03178_yuuryou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧: Bags cost extra

Many people bring their own ⟦エコバッグ→エコバッグ：08937_ekobaggu⟧ (eco-bag/reusable bag).
